_comment: Windows template for hongyan. Copy to %USERPROFILE%\.config\hongyan\config.json and fill in every UPPERCASE placeholder. The ACI is the only authentication - Signal validates it cryptographically; get yours by texting the bot once and reading the 'rejected' line in the audit log, or from Signal's own account settings.
_allowed_units_note: Windows service names restartable by voice. Find the exact name: powershell Get-Service *plex*
_services_note: type windows = a Windows service checked via Get-Service. The listener must run elevated (Task Scheduler: highest privileges) for restarts and reboots to work.
_custom_commands_note: Typed exactly, or reached by synonym. The 10-second delay on reboot is your abort window: 'shutdown /a' cancels it.
